title: MacaulayWinter/seq-resistome pipeline parameters
description: Antibiotic resistance genes in shotgun metagenomes: read-based counts against CARD, normalised, with denominators

input_output_options.title: Input/output options
input_output_options.description: Where the samples come from and where results go.

input.description: Samplesheet CSV: sample, fastq_1, fastq_2, then any study metadata columns (carried through to the tables). Several rows with one sample name are one sample in several files.

triage_results.description: A seq-triage results folder (its --outdir). Give it with the samplesheet seq-triage was run with: only samples seq-triage passed (PASS or WARN) as short-read metagenomes are analysed; the rest are listed in samples_left_out.tsv with the reason.

outdir.description: Directory for results. Created if it does not exist.

card_options.title: CARD
card_options.description: The Comprehensive Antibiotic Resistance Database: downloaded once from card.mcmaster.ca into a cache, checksum-checked on every run, never stored in the pipeline. Free for non-commercial research use only.

card_version.description: 'validated': the CARD release this pipeline version was validated with. 'latest': the newest CARD release; every output then says it was not validated by the pipeline authors.

card_cache.description: Folder CARD is kept in between runs. Default: ~/.seq-resistome/card

card_versions.description: Table of CARD releases with their pinned checksums.

host_removal_options.title: Host removal
host_removal_options.description: Reads from the host are removed with hostile before counting. Human by default.

host_index.description: A hostile standard index, fetched once into --host_cache (hostile's list: human-t2t-hla, human-t2t-hla-argos985, ...).

host_cache.description: Folder hostile indexes are kept in between runs. Default: ~/.seq-resistome/hostile

host_fasta.description: Your own host genome (FASTA) instead of --host_index; indexed with bowtie2 on each run.

skip_host_removal.description: Skip host removal (samples with no host, such as water or soil).

counting_options.title: Counting and normalisation
counting_options.description: The 16S denominator and when an ARG counts as detected.

rrna_16s.description: 16S rRNA reference FASTA file(s) for SortMeRNA, comma-separated. Default: SILVA bacteria and archaea 16S as shipped with SortMeRNA 4.3.7.

length_16s.description: Length (bp) one 16S gene copy is counted as: E. coli rrsB.

min_arg_reads.description: Fewest reads for an ARG to count as detected.

min_breadth_ratio.description: An ARG counts as detected only if its reads cover at least this share of the breadth that the same number of reads landing at random would cover.
